== frame after_transfers cursor=8,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cp exact-source exact-target
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cp --into copy-into into-source
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ mv move-source move-target
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ mv --into move-into move-into-source
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $

@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cp
@2 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@2 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 cp
@4 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@4 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 mv
@6 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@6 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 mv
@8 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== effect copy_into
|file 7 copy-into/into-source
== effect move_into
|file 7 move-into/move-into-source
